senses.gloss:
वौषट् वौषट्, ind. (perhaps for a form
वोक्षत् fr. rt. 1. वह्, and meaning ‘may he, i. e.
Agni, carry the offering to the gods;’ according to
others merely a lengthened form of वषट्, q. v.), an
exclamation or formula used on offering an oblation to
the gods or Manes with fire; [cf. Zend vaoshaṭ.]
